title: Magal Touba 2023-2024: A Formalized and Reproducible Data Engineering Pipeline for the Exploitation of Hospital Records during Mass Gatherings
description: Companion code and cleaned dataset (D_clean) for the CNRIA 2026 paper on a formalized, auditable data engineering pipeline (Phi = rho o delta o nu o tau) applied to CHAK hospital records during the 2023 and 2024 editions of the Grand Magal of Touba, Senegal.
